# ICLR 2027 Style

The `.sty` and `.bst` files here are unmodified files from the official archive:

https://media.iclr.cc/Conferences/ICLR2027/iclr-2027-style-files.zip

Retrieved 2026-09-15. SHA-256:

```text
0d940dfa9398ae99a18f24a85a8a683f367204b6af6d17d2899e60a67102529e  iclr-2027-style-files.zip
797deef41724e93761426ac0cbcca46279a91cc650dd1f0ce76a4f08d2098ea6  iclr2027_conference.sty
2d67552db7ed38ccfccb5957b52f95656e25c249724761d3cf5f7922ad1844c5  iclr2027_conference.bst
```

The preprint header adjustment is isolated in `../preamble.tex`. The review
build uses the official anonymous layout. Neither mode certifies submission
readiness or uploads anything. Standard TeX Live provides natbib and fancyhdr;
the archive's copies and example manuscript are not needed.
